pages.notes: Dacia UK price guide dated 1 July 2026 (18 pages), one price table per model: Spring (p4), Sandero (p6), Sandero Stepway (p8), New Jogger (p10), Duster (p12), Bigster (p14). Each table has grade bands (Essential/Expression/Journey/Extreme) with one row per engine; each row is a record. Prices are the 'ON THE ROAD PRICE*' column (OTR; the tables also give Basic, VAT and Total Retail Price). Excluded as commercial/van versions: Spring CARGO 70hp (p4; VED £360 and the table's '**Plug in Van Grant (£2,500)' footnote) and the separately headed DUSTER CARGO Expression 'Cargo hybrid 155' (p12; VED £360, no BIK). Options rows (paint, spare wheel, sunroof) and accessories pages are not records. Power: Spring's column is headed 'BHP', the others 'HP' (not marked DIN), all converted at ×0.7457. The Hybrid 155 rows' fuel is 'Petrol / Electric' (Jogger) or 'Hybrid' (Duster, Bigster), labelled hybrid; their HP figure (155) is the only power figure and is taken as the hybrid's output (the document doesn't say 'system'). Mild hybrid 140 rows have fuel 'Petrol' -> petrol. The Hybrid 150 4X4 rows (Duster Extreme, Bigster Journey/Extreme) give fuel only as 'Mild hybrid' and the document never names that engine's base fuel, so fuel_type is left out for them. Conflict: Bigster Journey 'mild hybrid 140' has 130 in its HP column (every other mild hybrid 140 row has 140); power_kw uses the HP column (130 -> 96.9 kW). Sandero Expression's row reads 'TCe MY26' (no number) but its HP column gives 100. CO2 is the 'CO2 G/KM WLTP' column; Spring's 0 is stated. Gearbox is never stated, so no automatic; no engine cc, seats, 0-62 or top speed are given. 'Dacia' is in the text. Model 'Jogger' drops the page heading's 'NEW'; 'Sandero Stepway' is kept whole as the document gives it its own page and contents entry. Grade names are printed in capitals in the tables and written title-case here. Power is left out where the document gives it only in a plain 'HP' column (neither DIN nor bhp: ambiguous); Spring's 'BHP' column is converted at x0.7457.

pages.notes: Renault UK range car price guide, prices valid from 1 October 2026 (23 pages). One VERSIONS price table per model, each row a record: Renault 4 (p3, 5 rows), Renault 5 (p5, 4), Scenic (p7, 3), Megane (p9, 2), Rafale (p11, 3), Austral (p13, 3), Symbioz (p15, 5), Captur (p17, 6), Clio (p19, 3). Options (paint, roofs, decals, spare wheel), accessories, service plans, extended warranty and the VED/BIK tables are not records; there are no van/Cargo versions. Prices are the 'Manufacturer's "on the road" R.R.P.*' column (OTR; the footnote says it includes delivery, plates, road fund licence and £55 first registration fee). For the four EVs the table also gives 'Manufacturer's "on the road price" RRP incl. ECG#', i.e. after the government Electric Car Grant is deducted; price_gbp uses the OTR RRP before the grant, not the grant-reduced figure. (Megane's footnote says the ECG is £1,500 while its table column says £3,750; this doesn't affect the labelled price.) Model: 'Renault 4' and 'Renault 5' are labelled model '4' and '5' (make dropped from the name per the rules, as for numeric models such as '3008'); E-Tech electric / E-Tech full hybrid / TCe115 in the page headings are powertrain names and are dropped; Megane drops the heading's 'NEW'. Trims are written lower-case as the document prints them ('techno esprit Alpine', 'iconic five+', 'roland garros+'); 'techno esprit Alpine' and 'iconic esprit Alpine' are kept whole as the options tables give them as columns of their own. Renault 4's 'techno+ plein sud™ canvas roof' and 'iconic+ plein sud™ canvas roof' rows are separate priced rows of the main table, so they are records, but their trim is 'techno+' / 'iconic+' (the options table heads them 'techno+ (incl canvas roof)', i.e. fitted equipment). Power: EV tables have a 'Power (kW / horsepower^)' column ('110 / 150'), so power_kw is the stated kW (the unit is only in the column header and the pair is kW-first, which the checker doesn't recognise). Hybrid/petrol tables have a 'Power (ps^)' column (^Metric horsepower (pferdestarke)), converted ×0.7355; that column beats the 'hp' in row names (they agree). Full hybrids' ps figure is the only power figure (not called system output). Captur TCe115 (115) and Clio 145 rows give the number only in the ps^ column, so the unit is in the header only. EV power check: 90 kW vs 120 hp and 160 kW vs 220 hp don't convert exactly; kW is used as stated. Fuel: 'electric (BEV)' -> ev; 'Petrol full hybrid (HEV)' / 'petrol - hybrid [HEV]' (self-charging) -> hybrid; Symbioz 'mild hybrid - petrol' -> petrol; Captur TCe115 'Petrol' -> petrol. CO2: the 'WLTP CO2 (g/km)*' column for hybrid/petrol rows; EV tables give only a 'CO2 Band' (A), never a g/km figure, so EV co2 is left out. No gearbox, engine cc, seats, 0-62 or top speed is stated anywhere, so automatic, engine_size_cc, seats, zero_to_62_s and top_speed_mph are left out. Clio's options table marks all three trims '^^ stock only'; they are still priced rows of the main table, so they are records. 'Renault' is in the text.

pages.notes: Price list (pages 16-19 of a 74-page book) covering two model years, both effective 1st September 2026: 2026 Model Year (p1-p2, model codes C1D...) and 2027 Model Year (p3-p4, C2D...); the model year is in each entity label. 32 priced variants: per model year, Icon, Design, GR SPORT (Bi-tone) and Excel (2027 MY: 'Excel (Pan Roof)') x 5 dr HB / Touring Sports x Petrol Hybrid 1.8 VVT-i (140 DIN hp) / 2.0 VVT-i (178 DIN hp), all Auto. The two model years' rows carry identical prices and CO2 but different model codes, and are kept as separate records. Trim is the grade without its parenthetical: 'GR SPORT (Bi-tone)' -> 'GR SPORT' and 'Excel (Pan Roof)' -> 'Excel' (the option tables head their columns 'Icon Design GR SPORT Excel', so the parenthetical is fitted equipment, not the grade name); the entity keeps the full grade text. Prices are the 'On the Road #' column (OTR; the table also gives Basic, VAT, Delivery & Plates and List Price). The 2026 MY 'Option Model Codes' rows (p2: Excel with Toyota Skyview Panoramic roof C1DAJ5-C1DAJ8, Excel with Bi-tone Paint C1DAJ9/C1DAN4) are a base grade with options fitted, so they aren't records (in the 2027 MY the pan-roof Excel is the main-table grade and is a record). Power is the 'DIN hp' column, the variant's only power figure, taken as the hybrid's output (the document doesn't say 'system'); DIN hp is metric horsepower, converted at x0.7355 (140 -> 103.0 kW, 178 -> 130.9 kW). CO2 is the per-variant g/km in the price table; it isn't labelled WLTP. Engine is given only in litres ('1.8 VVT-i', '2.0 VVT-i'), so no engine_size_cc. No seats, 0-62 or top speed stated. Make 'Toyota' is in the text ('Toyota Corolla PRICE LIST', 'Toyota Skyview').

pages.notes: Vauxhall Corsa price and specification guide, 1 April 2026, Model Year 2026B (18 pages). Main price tables on p7: PRICES ELECTRIC (YES, GS, Ultimate x Electric Propulsion 100kW (136PS) / 115kW (156PS) auto) and PRICES PETROL (YES, Design, GS, Ultimate x 1.2 (100PS) Turbo / Turbo auto / 1.2 (110PS) Turbo Hybrid e-DCT6 auto / 1.2 (145PS) Turbo Hybrid e-DCT6 auto; Design has no 145PS row and no electric rows). 21 records, one per p7 row. Prices are OTR: petrol 'ON-THE-ROAD RRP (£)'; electric 'ON-THE-ROAD RRP BEFORE ECG (£)', not the 'AFTER ECG' column (Electric Car Grant deducted, £1,500 less), as for the Cupra Born. The 1.2 (100PS) Turbo auto rows are footnoted '**... available from existing stock only for Northern Ireland' but are priced rows of the main table, so they are records. CO2 is each row's own p7 'WLTP COMBINED CO2 (G/KM)#' figure, footnoted '#Provisional ... determined according to the WLTP test cycle'; p13 gives per-engine combined low/high ranges (e.g. 117/119, 127/128) that bracket them. EV CO2 0 is stated in the p7 column and on p12. Turbo Hybrid e-DCT6 is a 48V mild hybrid (p14: 1.2-litre petrol engine, 21kW (28hp) e-motor, 'hybrid system's 48V battery'), so fuel_type petrol; power is the p13 PETROL ENGINES 'Maximum power' figure for that engine (110PS (81kW), 145PS (107kW)), the only power figure given for it (the 28hp/21kW e-motor figure is not used). Power is kW as stated (p13 '100PS (74kW)'; p7/p12 '100kW (136PS)', '115kW (156PS)'). Engine 1199cc for all three petrol engines (p13). 0-62 and top speed for petrol from p13's performance table, matched by engine and gearbox; for electric from p12 (0-62 8.2 secs for both motors; 'Maximum speed 93 mph' spans both columns). automatic: 'auto' rows and e-DCT6 (dual clutch) true; plain '1.2 (100PS) Turbo' rows false (p14 'Six-speed manual gearbox Petrol engine: 1.2 (100PS) Turbo'); EV true ('auto' in each row; p12 'Automatic electric drive with fixed gear ratio'). EV battery (50kWh/51kWh) follows the motor and isn't priced separately, so it isn't a separate dimension. Model: 'Corsa' for petrol/hybrid; 'Corsa Electric' for the EVs, which the document names as such (p12 'The Corsa Electric is a battery electric vehicle', p14 spec columns 'CORSA | CORSA ELECTRIC'); the p7 price table itself only heads them 'PRICES ELECTRIC'. Trim 'YES' as written in the price table. Seats left out: no seat count is stated. Make 'Vauxhall' from the text (p1 'VAUXHALL CORSA'). Minor slips, no effect on labels: YES 1.2 (145PS) hybrid's LCDV code repeats the 100PS auto's (1GJOA5HL81TX2CJ2); p14 brakes text writes 'Electric Propulsion 115kW (145PS) auto' where p7/p12 give 156PS.
